+def parse_authority(authority: str) -> tuple[str, str | None] | None:
+    """Parse an authority into its host and optional port components."""
+    if authority.startswith("["):
+        closing_bracket = authority.find("]")
+        if closing_bracket == -1:
+            return None
+
+        host = authority[: closing_bracket + 1]
+        ip_literal = host[1:-1]
+        if _IPV_FUTURE_RE.fullmatch(ip_literal) is None:
+            try:
+                ipaddress.IPv6Address(ip_literal)
+            except ValueError:
+                return None
+
+        remainder = authority[closing_bracket + 1 :]
+        if not remainder:
+            return host, None
+        if not remainder.startswith(":"):
+            return None
+        port = remainder[1:]
+    else:
+        if authority.count(":") > 1:
+            return None
+        host, separator, port = authority.partition(":")
+        if _REG_NAME_RE.fullmatch(host) is None:
+            return None
+        if not separator:
+            return host, None
+
+    if not port or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", port) is None:
+        return None
+    return host, port
+

+    """Return whether a syntactically numeric port is in the URI port range."""
+    if port is None:
+        return True
+    normalized = port.lstrip("0") or "0"
+    return len(normalized) < 5 or (len(normalized) == 5 and normalized <= "65535")
+
